newsitem.title: PANAMA: Tropical version of Guinness in Panama.
newsitem.headline: Tropical version of Guinness in Panama.

text.p: A smoother version of Guinness Foreign Extra Stout -- one that is more palatable to consumers in the tropics -- is now available in Panama's bars and supermarkets.
Cervecerias Baru Panama SA on Wednesday officially launched the new beer, produced under a licensing agreement with Guinness Plc, assistant general manager Ricardo Endara said.

Endara told Reuters the local brewery would distribute and bottle the new version of the stronger Guinness Foreign Extra Stout, available in Panama since 1956. A similar product is already on sale in El Salvador.

"We did a taste market after El Salvador and the response was overwhelming," Endara said. "In the tropics, the weather is too hot and humid for such a heavy beer. The new softer version keeps the same quality and character."
